reason: Internal: design bundle only, no code. Records Step 0 of design/evaluation/ — the check specified as able to withdraw the whole bundle. It did not fire. Two components were compared against production construction of the same component and both diverge in bytes that reach the model. RelevanceGate: 539 vs 559 bytes for the same window; the eval-built gate loses the operator-canonical sender name and the media description, and production documents on the line that passes media_join that an image-only message then reads as an empty body whose row render_context drops. FirePath: three prompt blocks empty or absent, caused by three integers that default to zero when not passed — self_card_conclusions 8 to 0, people_in_window_conclusions 3 to 0, people_in_window_speakers 4 to 0 — and the last triggers an early return at fire.py:1122 so the people_in_window block is not rendered at all, while decisions and media_join are also unpassed. So the proactive_act suite, graded on what the room heard, measures an agent that does not know who is in the room, carries no self-account, has no memory of its own prior decisions and cannot see photographs. Nothing guards this: the parity test compares composition.py against offline.py, both of which pass FirePath with 36 arguments, and never reads eval_support.py. Also settled: the cost objection both reviews raised is false. Building the production composition root costs 61 to 84 milliseconds per case against one session-scoped container and a template-cloned database, not a container per case, so a case can be plain data. Five components remain unchecked and each could still come back empty.
